name: Harness Governance Plugin
description: Package harness reflection, proposal drafting, and regression evaluation into one governed harness-improvement plugin with explicit human gates.

limitations: Harness adoption remains human-approved; the packaged Markdown hook is advisory on runtimes without a native enforcement mapping.
usability.quickstart: Run `node scripts/first_use.mjs examples/first-use-input.json` after installation to produce a governed proposal decision.

limitations: Requires a declared Node.js 22 execution capability; it never authorizes harness adoption.

authentication.credential_storage: No credentials are used by this instruction bundle.
authentication.validation: Confirm no authentication challenge is introduced by runtime wiring.
authentication.revocation: Not applicable; remove the installed bundle to withdraw it.
